QuestInfo.name: A Much-Needed Break
QuestInfo.0: Kimu, who is next to Kizan, is smiling at you. That probably means he has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: Kimu gave you a cool drink. You should try it! Press the hotkey I to open the inventory window, and then double-click on the drink to, y'know, drink it.
QuestInfo.2: Whoo! That was refreshing! You also feel a bit stronger now.

1.0: Feeling better? You should have something to replenish your energy. Try out some of these consumables I just got.\r\n

yes.0: Don't be afraid to burn through your potions. They're cheap and tasty. Go see Kizan now that you're back to full health!

item.0: Open your inventory with the I key and double-click on one of those drinks I gave you.
